import re
src = open('src/policy.rs').read()
src = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/', '', src)
known = dict(re.findall(r'\bconst\s+(\w+)\s*:[^=]+=\s*([^;]+);', src))
start = re.search(r'\bfn\s+upload\s*\(\s*\)', src).end()
i = j = src.index('{', start)
depth = 0
while True:
    depth += (src[j] == '{') - (src[j] == '}')
    j += 1
    if depth == 0:
        break
body = src[i:j]
for name, value in re.findall(r'\blet\s+(?:mut\s+)?(\w+)\s*(?::[^=;]+)?=\s*([^;]+);', body):
    known[name] = value
def value(field):
    m = re.search(r'(?<![\w.])' + field + r'\b\s*(?::\s*(&?\s*\[[^\]]*\]|[^,}\n]+))?\s*[,}\n]',
                  body[body.rindex('Policy'):])
    assert m, field
    v = (m.group(1) or field).strip()
    for _ in range(4):
        v = known.get(v.lstrip('& ').split('::')[-1], v).strip()
    return v
def number(field):
    out = 1
    text = value(field)
    m = re.fullmatch(r'\(?(?:std::time::)?Duration::from_(secs|millis)\((\w+)\)\.as_millis\(\)\)?\s+as\s+u64', text)
    if m:
        text = m.group(2) + (' * 1000' if m.group(1) == 'secs' else '')
    for part in text.split('*'):
        part = re.sub(r'\bas\s+u(32|64)\b|[()]', '', part).strip()
        part = known.get(part, part)
        out *= int(re.sub(r'_|u32|u64|\s', '', part))
    return out
assert number('max_attempts') == 7

# LED states

`config/led_states.json` maps each state to how the status LED shows it:

| field | meaning | default |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `white`, `green`, `yellow`, `red` or `blue` | `white` |

| `period_ms` | blink period, only for `blink` | 500 |
| `pattern` | for error codes: `S` short and `L` long pulses, in order | `""` |

Top-level fields: `states` (an object with `boot`, `updating`, `error`, `standby`),
`standby_brightness_pct` (default 40) and `low_battery_mv` (default 3300).
